sn4.5:1.5: etadavoca muttāhaṁ → etad avoca mutto ham (pts)
sn4.5:2.1: muttāhaṁ → muttohaṁ (bj) | muttohaṁ → muttāhaṁ (bj: machasaṁ, syā)
sn4.5:2.2: mānusā → Here S2 intercalates: [mārabandhana mutta] ettha, and S1 [māra bandhanamuttomhi ti hato tvam] ettha. (pts note)
sn4.5:2.3: lokānukampāya → lokānukampakāya (pts) | lokānukampāya → lokānukampakāya (bj: sīmu7, PTS)
sn4.5:2.4: agamittha → agamettha (pts) | agamittha → agamattha (bj: sīmu7) | agamettha → B. agamattha (Vinaya, agamittha). (pts note)
sn4.5:2.6: assavanatā → assavaṇatā (bj) | assavanatā → So B. and C.; SS. assavantā; Childers: assavanato (word parihāyati). (pts note)
sn4.5:2.8: senānigamo → senāninigamo (bj) | senāninigamo → senānigamo (bj: machasaṁ, syā, PTS) | senānigamo → vinayapotthake yena uruvelā yena senānigamoti īdiso pāṭho dissati (sya-all note) | Senānigamo → B. Sena. In the Vinaya: yena Uruvelā yena senā- (Comp. Rh. D. and O's note, "Vinaya Texts," I. 113). (pts note)
sn4.5:4.1: muttāhaṁ → bhagavā muttohaṁ (bj); muttohaṁ (sya-all, pts) | Mutto-haṁ → B. muttāham. (pts note)
sn4.5:5.1: ti → All this text is to be found in the Mahāvaggo of the Vinaya at the end of the Mārakathā (11th Chapter). (pts note)
